### Our Sufficiency Comes from God (2 Corinthians 3:5) - Your Daily Bible Verse - June 8
Author: Anne Peterson  
Site: Crosswalk.com  
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-june-8.html  
Passage: 2 Corinthians 3:5  
Points:
- Cultural messages urge people toward self-reliance, fostering a misleading illusion of control.
- Unavoidable life trials expose human helplessness and can quickly lead to despair.
- God does not leave believers on their own; He supplies the strength required for every hardship.
- Just as Jesus immediately rescued Peter from sinking, God lifts up His children when they stumble.
- Real peace comes from acknowledging that all our sufficiency comes from God rather than self.

### The Joy of Inadequacy - Truth For Life - May 12
Author: Alistair Begg  
Site: Crosswalk.com  
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-may-12-2023.html  
Passage: 2 Corinthians 3:5-6  
Points:
- Worldly culture and church leadership often mistakenly prize charisma and ambition over godly humility.
- Self-reliance and perceived personal adequacy act as major barriers to being used by God.
- The new covenant established by Jesus demonstrates that believers bring nothing of their own except need.
- Acknowledging personal weakness before God opens the door for Christ's strength to be displayed.
- Resting in God's sufficiency produces true spiritual freedom and faith-filled boldness.
